title: ETH Atticc
tagline: Atticc is a decentralised social media for NFT communities. Atticc provides a one-stop-shop for NFT communities to launch, grow and monetise using a suite of crypto native features, while returning the ownership of identity, data and monetisation to users.
description: On Atticc users sign-in with Ethereum to start their Web3 social journey. Anyone can launch an NFT community in under a minute for free, after which they will discover a range of crypto native features to help them grow and monetise from their content and community engagement. Atticc is also a perfect place for peer-to-peer NFT trading, where users can initiate a trading offer while browsing other people's NFT collections. Together Atticc provides a  powerful Web3 social experience to crypto native users.
how_its_made:
Atticc is built with a range of technologies including many from EthOnline sponsors. These technologies allowed us to built a powerful social media app that is sufficiently decentralised. 
We embedded P2P NFT trading, users can initiate a trading offer with their ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 tokens while browsing the NFT collections of other people. Technologies used including those from sponsors are
XMTP - Encrypted and interoperable messaging
CyberConnect - Decentralised social graph
NFT.Storage - Images of NFTs created on Atticc are saved on NFT.Storage
ENS - We enable users to use ENS as username
POAP - Displayed on user profiles
OAT - Project Galaxy OAT display
0x - We use 0x's audited protocol for our P2P trading
